comparison.objective: Mount a filled malt cup on a spindle mixer so the spindle enters it and the cup actuates the motor switch without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Tilt-constrained loaded-vessel insertion around an obstructing spindle, rim/guide engagement, and precise seating.
comparison.success_condition: Cup seated on the run step with spindle inside and switch on, upright, still, spill-free, and released for one second.
comparison.reason: PR-1869 tests constrained insertion and seating of one loaded cup. It does not selectively pass one population of free bodies through apertures while retaining another, despite both requiring spill-aware load control.
